name: Lazise (Italy)
description: Navy blue field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Lazise (blue and white lozengy and a red dragon on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Lazise, a comune in Veneto; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Lazise arms — blue and white lozengy and a red dragon on yellow, crowned
